about: The secreta of the formulary “Holy Thursday — Mass of the Lord's Supper” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech Thee, O holy Lord, almighty Father, eternal God, may He render our sacrifice acceptable unto Thee Who by today's institution showed His disciples that it was to be offered in remembrance of Him: Jesus Christ, Thy Son, our Lord. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
